title: myself/yourself/themselves etc.
subtitle: Возвратные местоимения, each other и «сам» для усиления

theory.text: Возвратные местоимения нужны, когда подлежащее и дополнение — одно и то же лицо: Anna introduced herself (Анна представила себя). Русское «-ся/себя» часто переводится именно так.

items: Don't blame yourself. He hurt himself. Help yourselves!
После feel, relax, concentrate, meet возвратное местоимение не нужно: I feel better. I can't concentrate.
Обычно не нужно и после wash, shave, dress: He washed and got dressed.

theory.text: They looked at themselves — каждый смотрел на себя (в зеркало). They looked at each other — друг на друга. Вместо each other можно one another.
«Сам, сама» для усиления: I repaired my bike myself (сам, без помощи), You can do it yourself, The hotel itself was OK (сам отель).
Русское «-ся» не всегда = myself. Не говорите I feel myself bad или relax yourself — правильно I feel bad, relax. А «встретимся» — просто meet.

en: She paid for herself.
Anna introduced herself to the guests.
Do you talk to yourself?
Help yourselves!
We enjoyed ourselves at the party.
We really enjoyed ourselves at the party.
We had a great time at the party.
Be careful! Don't cut yourself!
Careful! Don't cut yourself!
He fell over, but he didn't hurt himself.
He fell, but he didn't hurt himself.
He fell down, but he didn't hurt himself.
Don't blame yourself.

items.ru: Я устал и не могу сосредоточиться.
en: I'm tired and I can't concentrate.
I'm tired and can't concentrate.
Where shall we meet on Saturday?
Where are we meeting on Saturday?
Where should we meet on Saturday?

items.ru: Сегодня я чувствую себя гораздо лучше.
en: I feel much better today.
Today I feel much better.
I feel a lot better today.
He got up, washed and got dressed.
He got up, washed and dressed.

items.ru: Сара и Кейт посмотрели на себя в зеркало.
en: Sarah and Kate looked at themselves in the mirror.

items.ru: Они посмотрели друг на друга и засмеялись.
en: They looked at each other and laughed.
They looked at one another and laughed.

items.ru: Как давно вы с Джоном знаете друг друга?
en: How long have you and John known each other?
How long have you and John known one another?
We don't see each other very often.
We don't see one another very often.

en: They don't talk to each other any more.
They don't talk to each other anymore.
They don't speak to each other any more.
They don't speak to each other anymore.

I fixed my bike myself.
I repaired my bicycle myself.
I fixed my bicycle myself.

You can make dinner yourself.

en: The hotel itself was OK, but the food was terrible.
The hotel itself wasn't bad, but the food was terrible.

The hotel itself wasn't bad, but the food was awful.

Emma herself told me.

en: The children can take care of themselves.
